open_response:
Capital punishment is an outdated and cruel practice that has no place in a civilized society. The death penalty is barbaric and unjustiﬁed for a variety of reasons. For one, it is an irreversible punishment that cannot be taken back once carried out. This means that even if the person is later proven innocent, they will have already been killed, and their loved ones will have lost a family member forever. It is also a costly punishment, with estimates suggesting that the death penalty costs more than life imprisonment due to the elaborate legal proceedings and appeals. Moreover, there is a risk of executing innocent people, as the system is not perfect and mistakes can be made. Finally, it is a form of state-sponsored violence that goes against the principles of justice and mercy. The death penalty is a relic of the past that should be abolished, and society should focus on rehabilitation and punishment that is proportionate to the crime committed.
